versos.grego: μιμηταί μου γίνεσθε, καθὼς κἀγὼ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.
controles.kjv: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.
controles.livre: Sede meus imitadores, assim como eu também sou de Cristo.

versos.grego: Ἐπαινῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς ὅτι πάντα μου μέμνησθε καὶ καθὼς παρέδωκα ὑμῖν τὰς παραδόσεις κατέχετε.

controles.web: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.
controles.kjv: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.
controles.livre: Eu vos louvo, irmãos, de que em tudo vos lembrais de mim, e retendes minhas ordens, assim como eu vos entreguei.

versos.grego: Θέλω δὲ ὑμᾶς εἰδέναι ὅτι παντὸς ἀνδρὸς ἡ κεφαλὴ ὁ Χριστός ἐστιν, κεφαλὴ δὲ γυναικὸς ὁ ἀνήρ, κεφαλὴ δὲ τοῦ Χριστοῦ ὁ Θεός.

controles.web: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is the man, and the head of Christ is God.
controles.kjv: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.
controles.livre: Mas quero que saibais, que a cabeça de todo homem é Cristo; e a cabeça da mulher é o homem; e a cabeça de Cristo é Deus.

versos.grego: πᾶς ἀνὴρ προσευχόμενος ἢ προφητεύων κατὰ κεφαλῆς ἔχων καταισχύνει τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.
controles.kjv: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.
controles.livre: Todo homem que ora ou profetiza, tendo alguma coisa sobre a cabeça, desonra sua própria cabeça.

versos.grego: πᾶσα δὲ γυνὴ προσευχομένη ἢ προφητεύουσα ἀκατακαλύπτῳ τῇ κεφαλῇ καταισχύνει τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτῆς· ἓν γάρ ἐστιν καὶ τὸ αὐτὸ τῇ ἐξυρημένῃ.

controles.web: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head unveiled dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.
controles.kjv: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.
controles.livre: Mas toda mulher que ora ou profetiza com a cabeça descoberta, desonra sua própria cabeça; porque é o mesmo que se a tivesse raspada.

versos.grego: εἰ γὰρ οὐ κατακαλύπτεται γυνή, καὶ κειράσθω· εἰ δὲ αἰσχρὸν γυναικὶ τὸ κείρασθαι ἢ ξυρᾶσθαι, κατακαλυπτέσθω.

controles.web: For if a woman is not covered, let her also be shorn. But if it is shameful for a woman to be shorn or shaved, let her be covered.
controles.kjv: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.
controles.livre: Porque se a mulher não se cobre, raspe-se também; mas se para a mulher é vergonhoso se cortar ou se raspar, que se cubra.

versos.grego: ἀνὴρ μὲν γὰρ οὐκ ὀφείλει κατακαλύπτεσθαι τὴν κεφαλήν, εἰκὼν καὶ δόξα Θεοῦ ὑπάρχων· ἡ γυνὴ δὲ δόξα ἀνδρός ἐστιν.

controles.web: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.
controles.kjv: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.
controles.livre: Porque o homem não deve cobrir a cabeça, pois é a imagem e a glória de Deus; mas a mulher é a glória do homem.

versos.grego: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν ἀνὴρ ἐκ γυναικός, ἀλλὰ γυνὴ ἐξ ἀνδρός·

controles.web: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;
controles.kjv: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.
controles.livre: Porque o homem não provem da mulher, mas sim a mulher do homem.

versos.grego: καὶ γὰρ οὐκ ἐκτίσθη ἀνὴρ διὰ τὴν γυναῖκα, ἀλλὰ γυνὴ διὰ τὸν ἄνδρα.

controles.web: for neither was man created for the woman, but woman for the man.
controles.kjv: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.
controles.livre: Porque também o homem não foi criado por causa da mulher, mas a mulher foi criada por causa do homem.

versos.grego: διὰ τοῦτο ὀφείλει ἡ γυνὴ ἐξουσίαν ἔχειν ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς διὰ τοὺς ἀγγέλους.

controles.web: For this cause the woman ought to have authority on her head, because of the angels.
controles.kjv: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.
controles.livre: Portanto a mulher deve ter sobre a cabeça sinal de autoridade, por causa dos anjos.

versos.grego: πλὴν οὔτε γυνὴ χωρὶς ἀνδρὸς οὔτε ἀνὴρ χωρὶς γυναικὸς ἐν Κυρίῳ·

controles.web: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.
controles.kjv: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.
controles.livre: Porém, nem o homem é sem a mulher, nem a mulher sem o homem, no Senhor.

versos.grego: ὥσπερ γὰρ ἡ γυνὴ ἐκ τοῦ ἀνδρός, οὕτως καὶ ὁ ἀνὴρ διὰ τῆς γυναικός· τὰ δὲ πάντα ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.
controles.kjv: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.
controles.livre: Porque assim como a mulher vem do homem, assim também é o homem pela mulher; porém tudo vem de Deus.

versos.grego: ἐν ὑμῖν αὐτοῖς κρίνατε· πρέπον ἐστὶν γυναῖκα ἀκατακάλυπτον τῷ Θεῷ προσεύχεσθαι;

controles.web: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?
controles.kjv: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?
controles.livre: Julgai-vos entre vós mesmos: é decente que a mulher ore a Deus descoberta?

versos.grego: οὐδὲ ἡ φύσις αὐτὴ διδάσκει ὑμᾶς ὅτι ἀνὴρ μὲν ἐὰν κομᾷ, ἀτιμία αὐτῷ ἐστιν,

controles.web: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?
controles.kjv: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?
controles.livre: Ou não vos ensina a mesma natureza, que ter cabelo longo é desonra para o homem?

versos.grego: γυνὴ δὲ ἐὰν κομᾷ, δόξα αὐτῇ ἐστιν; ὅτι ἡ κόμη ἀντὶ περιβολαίου δέδοται αὐτῇ.

controles.web: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.
controles.kjv: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.
controles.livre: Mas a mulher ter cabelo longo, lhe é honra, porque os cabelos lhe são dados por cobertura?

versos.grego: Εἰ δέ τις δοκεῖ φιλόνεικος εἶναι, ἡμεῖς τοιαύτην συνήθειαν οὐκ ἔχομεν, οὐδὲ αἱ ἐκκλησίαι τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.
controles.kjv: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.
controles.livre: Porém se alguém parece ser inclinado a disputas, nós não temos tal costume, nem as igrejas de Deus.

versos.grego: Τοῦτο δὲ παραγγέλλων οὐκ ἐπαινῶ ὅτι οὐκ εἰς τὸ κρεῖσσον ἀλλὰ εἰς τὸ ἧσσον συνέρχεσθε.

controles.web: But in giving you this command, I don’t praise you, that you come together not for the better but for the worse.
controles.kjv: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.
controles.livre: Mas isto eu vos declaro, que não vos louvo, porque vós vos ajuntais, não para melhor, mas para pior.

versos.grego: πρῶτον μὲν γὰρ συνερχομένων ὑμῶν ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ ἀκούω σχίσματα ἐν ὑμῖν ὑπάρχειν, καὶ μέρος τι πιστεύω.

controles.web: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.
controles.kjv: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.
controles.livre: Porque, em primeiro lugar, eu ouço que, quando vos ajuntais, há divisões entre vós; e em parte eu acredito.

versos.grego: δεῖ γὰρ καὶ αἱρέσεις ἐν ὑμῖν εἶναι, ἵνα καὶ οἱ δόκιμοι φανεροὶ γένωνται ἐν ὑμῖν.

controles.web: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.
controles.kjv: For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.
controles.livre: Porque é necessário que haja diferenças de opinião  entre vós, para que os que são aprovados sejam evidenciados entre vós.

versos.grego: Συνερχομένων οὖν ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ οὐκ ἔστιν κυριακὸν δεῖπνον φαγεῖν·

controles.web: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.
controles.kjv: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord’s supper.
controles.livre: Quando, pois, vós vos reunis, não é para comer da ceia do Senhor;

versos.grego: ἕκαστος γὰρ τὸ ἴδιον δεῖπνον προλαμβάνει ἐν τῷ φαγεῖν, καὶ ὃς μὲν πεινᾷ, ὃς δὲ μεθύει.

controles.web: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.
controles.kjv: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.
controles.livre: Porque cada um, comendo antes, toma sua própria ceia; e um fica com fome, e outro fica bêbado.

versos.grego: μὴ γὰρ οἰκίας οὐκ ἔχετε εἰς τὸ ἐσθίειν καὶ πίνειν; ἢ τῆς ἐκκλησίας τοῦ Θεοῦ καταφρονεῖτε, καὶ καταισχύνετε τοὺς μὴ ἔχοντας; τί εἴπω ὑμῖν; ἐπαινέσω ὑμᾶς; ἐν τούτῳ οὐκ ἐπαινῶ.

controles.web: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly, and put them to shame who don’t have? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.
controles.kjv: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.
controles.livre: Por acaso não tendes casas para comer e para beber? Ou desprezais a Igreja de Deus, e envergonhais os que não têm? Que vos direi? Eu vos elogiarei? Nisto eu não vos elogio.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ γὰρ παρέλαβον ἀπὸ τοῦ Κυρίου, ὃ καὶ παρέδωκα ὑμῖν, ὅτι ὁ Κύριος Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῇ νυκτὶ ᾗ παρεδίδετο ἔλαβεν ἄρτον

controles.web: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.
controles.kjv: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:
controles.livre: Porque eu recebi do Senhor o que também vos entreguei; que o Senhor Jesus, na noite em que foi traído, tomou o pão;

versos.grego: καὶ εὐχαριστήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ εἶπεν Τοῦτό μού ἐστιν τὸ σῶμα τὸ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν· τοῦτο ποιεῖτε εἰς τὴν ἐμὴν ἀνάμνησιν.

controles.web: When he had given thanks, he broke it, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”
controles.kjv: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.
controles.livre: E tendo dado graças, o partiu, e disse: Tomai, comei; isto é o meu corpo, que é partido por vós; fazei isto em memória de mim.

versos.grego: ὡσαύτως καὶ τὸ ποτήριον μετὰ τὸ δειπνῆσαι, λέγων Τοῦτο τὸ ποτήριον ἡ καινὴ διαθήκη ἐστὶν ἐν τῷ ἐμῷ αἵματι· τοῦτο ποιεῖτε, ὁσάκις ἐὰν πίνητε, εἰς τὴν ἐμὴν ἀνάμνησιν.

controles.web: In the same way he also took the cup, after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”
controles.kjv: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.
controles.livre: Semelhantemente também, depois de cear, tomou o copo, dizendo: Este copo é o novo Testamento em meu sangue. Fazei isto todas as vezes que o beberdes, em memória de mim.

versos.grego: ὁσάκις γὰρ ἐὰν ἐσθίητε τὸν ἄρτον τοῦτον καὶ τὸ ποτήριον πίνητε, τὸν θάνατον τοῦ Κυρίου καταγγέλλετε, ἄχρι οὗ ἔλθῃ.

controles.web: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.
controles.kjv: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord’s death till he come.
controles.livre: Porque todas as vezes que comerdes deste pão, e beberdes deste copo, anunciai a morte do Senhor, até que ele venha.

versos.grego: ὥστε ὃς ἂν ἐσθίῃ τὸν ἄρτον ἢ πίνῃ τὸ ποτήριον τοῦ Κυρίου ἀναξίως, ἔνοχος ἔσται τοῦ σώματος καὶ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ Κυρίου.

controles.web: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.
controles.kjv: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.
controles.livre: Portanto quem comer deste pão, ou beber deste copo do Senhor indignamente, será culpado do corpo e do sangue do Senhor.

versos.grego: δοκιμαζέτω δὲ ἄνθρωπος ἑαυτόν, καὶ οὕτως ἐκ τοῦ ἄρτου ἐσθιέτω καὶ ἐκ τοῦ ποτηρίου πινέτω·

controles.web: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread, and drink of the cup.
controles.kjv: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.
controles.livre: Portanto examine-se cada um a si mesmo, e assim coma deste pão, e beba deste copo.

versos.grego: ὁ γὰρ ἐσθίων καὶ πίνων κρίμα ἑαυτῷ ἐσθίει καὶ πίνει μὴ διακρίνων τὸ σῶμα.

controles.web: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself, if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.
controles.kjv: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord’s body.
controles.livre: Porque quem come e bebe indignamente, para si mesmo come e bebe condenação, não discernindo o corpo do Senhor.

versos.grego: διὰ τοῦτο ἐν ὑμῖν πολλοὶ ἀσθενεῖς καὶ ἄρρωστοι καὶ κοιμῶνται ἱκανοί.

controles.web: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.
controles.kjv: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.
controles.livre: Por esta causa há entre vós muitos fracos e doentes, e muitos que dormem.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ ἑαυτοὺς διεκρίνομεν, οὐκ ἂν ἐκρινόμεθα·

controles.web: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.
controles.kjv: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.
controles.livre: Porque se nós julgássemos a nós mesmos, não seríamos julgados.

versos.grego: κρινόμενοι δὲ ὑπὸ τοῦ Κυρίου παιδευόμεθα, ἵνα μὴ σὺν τῷ κόσμῳ κατακριθῶμεν.

controles.web: But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
controles.kjv: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.
controles.livre: Mas quando somos julgados, somos repreendidos pelo Senhor; para que não sejamos condenados com o mundo.

versos.grego: ὥστε, ἀδελφοί μου, συνερχόμενοι εἰς τὸ φαγεῖν ἀλλήλους ἐκδέχεσθε.

controles.web: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
controles.kjv: Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, tarry one for another.
controles.livre: Portanto, meus irmãos, quando vos ajuntardes para comer, esperai uns aos outros.

versos.grego: εἴ τις πεινᾷ, ἐν οἴκῳ ἐσθιέτω, ἵνα μὴ εἰς κρίμα συνέρχησθε. Τὰ δὲ λοιπὰ ὡς ἂν ἔλθω διατάξομαι.

controles.web: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.
controles.kjv: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ye come not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come.
controles.livre: Porém se alguém tiver fome, coma em casa; para que não vos ajunteis para sofrerdes julgamento. Quanto às demais coisas, as ordenarei quando vier.
